observation.command:
for p in externalPackages/materialize/materialize.min.js externalPackages/d3/d3.js externalPackages/d3/d3-scale-radial.js externalPackages/leaflet/leaflet.js externalPackages/Leaflet.markercluster/dist/leaflet.markercluster-src.js externalPackages/flatpickr.min.js src/js/configurators/DataExplorerConfigurator.js src/js/controllers/ProfilingController.js src/js/helpers/I18nTranslator.js src/js/helpers/BaseUtils.js i18n/en.json; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:8080/$p"); echo "$code  $p"; done
echo "--- html pages ---"
for p in index.html csvParse.html plausibilityCheck.html elasticsearchIndexAdministration.html examples/kosis/kosisDemo.html examples/komono/index.html; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:8080/$p"); echo "$code  $p"; done
